items.html: And with this you will understand the matter of the two hairs, which one must bring after thirteen years and one day. And it is as was stated above, concerning the ascent of ZON in the secret of MAN to AVI, that then he encounters the NHY of AVI, from which the Mochin are made for him, as will be stated, with God's help. And since he has already ascended to the Yesod of AVI, therefore there also begins in ZA the aspect of the lower beard, at the place of the completion of the Yesod of ZA himself; and they are the aspect of the two hairs mentioned in the words of our sages. But the upper beard of ZA does not begin until he is a son of twenty years, as will be stated below, with God's help.
